title: Hell
definition: Hell is the final state of conscious judgment for those who remain outside Christ.
summary: Hell is the final state of conscious judgment for those who remain outside Christ.
christFocus: Jesus warned about hell and gave Himself to save sinners from judgment.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Hell places present life under the future God has promised. Hell reveals the seriousness of sin against the holy god and the urgency of the gospel.

Scripture teaches the last things to produce hope, holiness, endurance, and urgency rather than speculation. People may either mock hell or use it manipulatively instead of speaking with sober truth and compassion.

Christ stands at the center of this future. Jesus warned about hell and gave Himself to save sinners from judgment. Because of Him, believers can face death, judgment, suffering, and the future with sober confidence rather than fear.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
The coming future exposes what truly matters now. People may either mock hell or use it manipulatively instead of speaking with sober truth and compassion. Scripture’s teaching about the last things steadies the heart in a world that feels unfinished.

It also guards the Church from fear-based prophecy and careless delay. The Lord calls His people to watchfulness, holiness, comfort, mission, and trust.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Speak of hell with tears, truth, humility, and a clear invitation to Christ. Bring this doctrine into prayer, Scripture, and daily obedience. Ask the Holy Spirit to make the truth real in your thinking, desires, relationships, and next faithful step with Christ.
